title: 38 Gallon Outdoor Trash Can, Waterproof Resin Garbage Bin With Lid & Drip Tray For Porch Backyard Patio, Black  Shipment From Walmart
body_html:
Convenient Drip Tray: Built-in sliding drip tray collects residual liquid and stains, easy to take out and wipe clean, greatly simplifying daily cleaning work.
Functional Double Lid: Practical double lid design firmly fixes garbage bags inside and efficiently isolates peculiar smells, keeping your outdoor living area clean and fresh all the time.
All-Weather & Easy Assembly: Weatherproof design fits porch, backyard, patio and more outdoor places, comes with detailed instructions for fast and effortless installation.
Large 32 Gallon Capacity: Generous inner storage space can hold a large amount of household waste, fully satisfying daily outdoor garbage storage and disposal demands.
